items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: >> [MR. PATRICK] My name is James Patrick, and I'm talking to Benny Carter.

ctx.x: My name is James Patrick, and I'm talking to Benny Carter. We're in Princeton, New Jersey, and it's October 14, 1976.

In this segment of the interview, we want to concentrate more on topics of specifically musical nature as opposed, perhaps to some of the more chronological or biographical things that have been discussed before, so that perhaps this segment of the interview will be somewhat more general with regard to dates, names and places and so forth. But we'll see.
